hero.title: Verified Goalkeeper Registry for Organized Turf Matches
hero.subtitle: Review vetted goalkeeper profiles across your district under transparent brokerage terms, dispatch match invitations, or register to the official roster.
hero.commissionNote: Brokerage standard: Goalkeepers define their net match payout; the platform applies a fixed 15% intermediary commission.

howItWorks.step1Desc: Specify match location, preferred weekday, and maximum fee threshold to filter active roster profiles.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Review the goalkeeper net match fee alongside the standardized 15% institutional brokerage commission.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Dispatch a match request through the registry and record a post-match performance rating.

filters.sectionSubtitle: Filter active goalkeepers by match schedule, district coverage, and experience tier.

grid.errorMessage: Unable to load goalkeeper directory due to a connection error.
grid.emptyTitle: No goalkeepers match the selected filters
grid.emptyDescription: Try widening your search by choosing another district, day, or budget limit.

bookingModal.title: Match Invitation & Fee Breakdown
bookingModal.subtitle: Review the brokerage fee calculation below to request this goalkeeper for your match.
bookingModal.organizerNotice: Once escrow booking is confirmed, kickoff time and turf venue details are verified via phone.
bookingModal.requestSentMessage: Match request recorded! You will be notified once the goalkeeper confirms.

registration.sectionTitle: Register to the Official Goalkeeper Roster
registration.sectionSubtitle: Define your experience tier, weekly schedule, and net per-match fee to receive match invitations from organizers.
registration.availableDaysHint: Select all weekdays on which you can accept match invitations.
registration.bioPlaceholder: Summarize your shot-stopping style, reflexes, and club or tournament background (15-280 chars).
registration.successMessage: Your goalkeeper profile has been recorded and published to the live directory.
